issue_1_shallow_readiness_blindspot.symptom: /ready returns 200 OK with database='connected' while real business endpoints fail
issue_1_shallow_readiness_blindspot.root_cause: SELECT 1 only proves TCP connectivity to the DB engine; it misses missing tables/unapplied Prisma migrations, broken application business logic, or broken downstream API paths because post-deploy smoke tests never exercised a real functional endpoint.
issue_1_shallow_readiness_blindspot.remediation: Upgrade /ready to query an actual schema table (e.g., lightweight link count/existence probe) and add functional end-to-end business smoke checks to the CI post-deploy verification gate.

issue_2_slow_memory_leak.symptom: Service heap memory climbs monotonically over time without crashing immediately
issue_2_slow_memory_leak.root_cause: Unbounded in-memory collection (e.g., uncapped fallbackQueue, un-evicted Map entries, or leaked event listeners) retaining object references per request, invisible to connectivity-only /ready checks until OS OOM-kill (ExitCode 137).
issue_2_slow_memory_leak.remediation: Enforce strict upper bounds (e.g., MAX_FALLBACK_QUEUE_SIZE = 1000) on all in-memory buffers/queues, configure container memory limits + --max-old-space-size, and add a Prometheus HighMemoryUsage / HeapGrowth alert rule in infra/alerts.yml.

issue_3_out_of_band_config_drift.symptom: Runtime configuration value diverges from what was last deployed through the CI/CD pipeline
issue_3_out_of_band_config_drift.root_cause: Manual ClickOps edit directly in the production platform UI bypassing GitOps/CI/CD, breaking auditability and reproducibility.
issue_3_out_of_band_config_drift.remediation: Lock production config to version-controlled manifests (fly.toml) and secret-manager audit trails, log a non-secret configuration hash/fingerprint at startup for drift detection, and forbid ad-hoc UI edits.
